name: John Rosecrans
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Kirkland, Washington
about: John Rosecrans is a partner at McKinley Irvin, located in Kirkland, Washington, where he focuses his practice on a wide range of family law matters. With a client-centered approach, he advises individuals and families navigating complex and often sensitive legal issues, including divorce, custody disputes and matters involving domestic relationships. He aims to provide practical guidance and effective advocacy tailored to the unique circumstances of each case.

Mr. Rosecrans handles cases involving alimony and spousal support, child support, custody and visitation, and dissolution of marriage. His practice also includes domestic violence matters, marital property division and alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation and collaborative law. In addition, he works with clients in same-sex family law matters, offering counsel that reflects an understanding of evolving legal frameworks and family dynamics. Through his work, he strives to help clients reach fair and sustainable outcomes while minimizing conflict where possible.

Admitted to practice in Washington in 2012, Mr. Rosecrans is also admitted to appear before the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington. He maintains active involvement in professional organizations, including the Washington State Bar Association’s Family Law Section, the King County Bar Association and Domestic Relations Attorneys of Washington, supporting his continued engagement with developments in family law.

Mr. Rosecrans graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree from Washington State University in 2006. He went on to pursue his legal studies at the Seattle University School of Law, where he established a foundation for his legal career and earned his Juris Doctor in 2012.

Over the years, Mr. Rosecrans has remained committed to guiding clients through challenging transitions with clarity and professionalism. He understands that family law matters often carry significant emotional and financial implications, and he works closely with clients to develop strategies that align with their goals while protecting their long-term interests.
